subject: business-studies
title: Sectors & Charities Adventure
welcome_lead: Not every business is for profit. Meet the sectors. 🏛️
meta_desc: Types of Business Adventure 3 — KS3 Business Studies on private, public sectors and charities.
final_note: You learned the three sectors and how charities and social enterprises work.

concepts.def: Businesses owned by people for profit
Owned by the government for citizens
Raises money to help a cause
Any extra money goes back to the cause

walkthroughs.body_html:
Private sector businesses are owned by people aiming for profit.

Examples: Tesco, your local barbershop, Netflix. 🎬

Public sector is run by government for everyone:

  • NHS — hospitals.
  • State schools.
  • The police and army.
  • Council bin collection.

Paid for by tax. 💷

Charities raise money for causes — Cancer Research, Oxfam, the RSPCA.

Social enterprises sell things but reinvest profit in their mission — like The Big Issue.

All not-for-profit. 🤝
